description: Write or draw the supplied color-aware reference with physical markers.
count_scope: 10,000 native variations and seven fixed task presets

evaluator.scope: Environment-owned task success; not physical qualification.

qualification: Defined task catalogue; does not imply every variation passed physical qualification.

task_set.score_rule: 1 on success, otherwise 0.9 x continuous progress; untouched starts score zero
task_set.legacy: Omitted selection and all native variation/split/kind/selection_seed requests use the native resolver. Named presets require their explicit contract.
task_set.launch: Resolve with GAR tasks and launch its LaunchSpec/TaskSpec (including saved manifests and managed sessions), or construct NewtonWhiteboardTaskSetBackend directly. The registry factory creates native whiteboard sessions only.
task_set.qualification: Checked by constructed-state unit tests only; the seven presets have not been run with the simulator or rendered.
